name: Adaptive Exercise Recognition - Personalized ML Case Study
description: An AI-powered adaptive exercise recognition system for Vantage Fit that evolved from pose-landmark movement tracking and rule-based squat detection into a validation-gated TensorFlow Lite classifier with anti-cheat logic and a personalization feedback loop.
role: Designed exercise-recognition logic on top of existing pose landmarks, used background session recordings during testing to understand real user behavior, introduced environmental and sensor validation, migrated deterministic recognition to ML, and shaped the personalization architecture.
challenge: Real users found ways to game the detector by lying down, changing phone orientation, exercising in poor lighting, and showing prerecorded squat videos, forcing the system to evolve through independent validation gates instead of relying on one computer-vision decision.
note: Conceptual architecture only. This portfolio avoids proprietary source code, sensitive anti-cheat implementation details, and unprovided performance metrics.

name: Tapori AI - Android & Flutter AI Chat Application
description: An AI-powered conversational mobile application with contextual chat, authentication, credit management, payments, Supabase Edge Functions, and LLM integration. Originally built natively for Android and later migrated to Flutter while preserving Clean Architecture and backend contracts.
role: Built the native Android foundation and migrated the client to Flutter while preserving product behavior, architecture boundaries, and backend contracts.
challenge: Keep authentication, credits, HTTP 402 handling, payment flow, and API contracts stable while moving from native Android patterns to Flutter, Riverpod, Dio, and GoRouter.
note: Flutter implementation: master-flutter branch. The Play Store listing is preserved without implying the Flutter client is the current production Play Store build.

name: ArchGuard
description: Executable architecture rules for Android teams that want feature-first validation and Clean Architecture enforcement.
role: Designed Gradle-based developer tooling to make architecture decisions repeatable and inspectable.
challenge: Turn architecture conventions into repeatable checks and readable HTML reports instead of relying only on code review memory.

name: SonicBridge
description: TV-to-mobile low-latency audio streaming over local Wi-Fi for private listening without cloud services or expensive dedicated hardware.
role: Designed the Android TV capture-to-mobile playback system as an engineering case study.
challenge: Capture Android TV audio, stream PCM over WebSockets, and play it on mobile through AudioTrack with practical buffering trade-offs.

name: Biometric SDK
description: Reusable Android SDK that wraps biometric authentication behind a cleaner integration surface.
role: Packaged lifecycle-aware BiometricPrompt integration into reusable developer-facing APIs.
challenge: Hide platform complexity while preserving lifecycle correctness and simple adoption in Android apps.

name: Sally Launcher
description: Custom Android launcher focused on a clean, smooth user experience and fast access to core phone actions.
role: Built a focused Android launcher around everyday mobile ergonomics.
challenge: Keep the experience fast, calm, and useful without making the home screen feel busy.

name: Vantage Circle & Vantage Fit
description: Enterprise Android applications serving employee engagement and wellness, modernized through MVVM, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, performance work, and reusable components.
role: Senior Android Developer with ownership across modernization, architecture, Compose migration, and platform readiness.
challenge: Modernize production Android surfaces while supporting active enterprise product delivery.

name: Medium Articles
description: Practical notes on Android architecture, Compose, performance, Clean Architecture, and the craft of shipping mobile software.
